verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents its own REST API (OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, versioned /rest/v0 base path) and a separate sandbox server, so the product can be driven programmatically without the UI. The sandbox is a real isolated environment, not a dry-run mode, which suits automated testing. However, access is request-gated, sandbox credentials are issued manually, and nothing documents a CLI, headless runner, or CI integration. missing for 10: CLI or documented headless/CI execution mode, self-serve credentials for automation, CI-specific guidance or examples, independent corroboration of automated usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Our API was originally architected for deep platform-to-platform integrations.
Puzzle publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document
Sandbox Server: https://staging.southparkdata.com / Production Server: https://api.puzzle.io
API access is request-gated (api@puzzle.io) per the getting-started page.
